items.title: TODAY: Preparing UK businesses for European sustainability reporting requirements
items.summary: Happening on 15 September, edie’s new webinar will explore what the European Sustainability Reporting Standards for Third-Country Groups (ESRS-TC) could mean for UK-headquartered businesses.

items.title: Waitrose and Novo Nordisk validate new science-based nature targets
items.summary: The Science Based Targets Network (SBTN) has announced a wave of new companies that have validated progress on science-based targets for nature, including Waitrose and healthcare giant Novo Nordisk.

items.title: TWO DAYS to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: UK and US deepen partnership to catalyse commercial fusion
items.summary: The UK Government has confirmed two agreements with the US to accelerate clean energy roll-out, which should also help deliver over 10,000 UK jobs by 2030.

items.title: Energy UK, Which? and Greenpeace join call for electricity levy overhaul
items.summary: More than 120 businesses, trade bodies, charities, unions and campaign groups have written to Chancellor John Healey, calling for levies to be moved off electricity bills and onto general taxation.
